g.title: macros
g.text: oams_macros.cfg, one toolchange (T<n>) from top to bottom

g.title: t_n
g.text: the slicer: print start and each colour change

g.title: plan_u
g.text: Panel Unload only: its own plan, homes if needed

g.title: plan
g.text: works out the temperature, shows the plan on the displays

g.title: home
g.text: only if the printer isn't homed

g.title: hb_tx
g.text: yours, if you wrote one (run by _OAMS_HEAT)

g.title: hb_u
g.text: yours, if you wrote one (run by _OAMS_HEAT)

g.title: heat_tx
g.text: heats and waits, only if the nozzle is colder

g.title: feed
g.text: the AMS feeds the group's next spool to the extruder gears,

g.title: heat_u
g.text: heats and waits, only if the nozzle is colder

g.title: follow
g.text: the AMS follows the extruder backwards

g.title: ret1
g.text: a short retract before the cut

g.title: cut
g.text: the cutter moves: pre_cut → cut → post_cut

g.title: ocut
g.text: CUT_FILAMENT runs it instead of the moves

g.title: ret2
g.text: pulls the cut end out of the extruder gears

g.title: ret3
g.text: an extra retract before the rewind

g.title: rewind
g.text: the AMS rewinds the filament to its bay

g.title: h_ret
g.text: yours, if you wrote one (a swap only)

g.title: reload
g.text: the extruder pushes it from the gears into the melt zone:

g.title: restore
g.text: heater back (idle printer only), toolhead back to the print

g.title: failnote
g.text: puts the G-code state back without moving, stops the AMS follower,
then an error; during a print PAUSE first, and the error ends the print
(on_error_gcode). From the panel, only an error. The heater stays on. The panel's Stop button
ends the sequence the same way, before the next step.

g.title: b_feed
g.text: the AMS feeds to the extruder gears

g.title: b_tl
g.text: heats if the spool's temperature is known

g.title: b_rel
g.text: the same move as a toolchange

g.title: runout
g.text: no macro runs: OpenAMS feeds a spare bay of the same group,
or runs PAUSE when it has none

g.title: b_fol
g.text: the AMS follows the extruder backwards

g.title: b_ej
g.text: heats if colder, 10 mm forward to soften
the tip, 100 mm back in 25 mm moves

g.title: b_rew
g.text: the AMS rewinds it to its bay
